# Arthur Santos Vieira Silva — Software Engineer

> Software engineer in Recife, Brazil. 4+ years at Moises building data pipelines, CRM automations, machine learning models and AI integrations with Python, TypeScript, Terraform and Google Cloud. BS in Computer Science, Federal University of Pernambuco (UFPE).

## Experience

- **Software Engineer, Moises** (2022 – present, remote)
  - Built a microservices social media observability pipeline with Python, Terraform, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub and BigQuery, giving real-time metrics across social platforms.
  - Implemented CRM and automations (Salesforce, Apex, Google Apps Script, Google Cloud, Python) that improved the influencer-marketing team's efficiency by over 60%.
  - Created the GCP structure hosting Python services triggered from a Flask front-end, with continuous deployment via GitHub Actions.
  - Built a lead-scoring machine learning model (Python, PyTorch, web/social scraping) that helped close 200+ contracts in one quarter; maintains a 10K+ lead database.
- **Software Engineer Intern, Moises** (2021 – 2022, remote)
  - Hired after winning 1st place in a chord-recognition challenge; the algorithm (Python, ML, music identification, React front-end) reached production in an app with 50M+ users.
- **PIBITI Researcher, UFPE** (2017 – 2022) — research and papers on software requirements engineering for startups and IoT.
- **Junior Backend Engineer, Accenture** (2017 – 2018) — Bash/Unix automations for daily health checks; legacy Java review and documentation.
- **Summer Job Intern, CESAR** (2017) — Android + OpenCV real-time guided city tour for EPSON Moverio AR glasses, built in six weeks.

## Projects

- [Ranking Político](https://arthurwkm.github.io/ranking-politico/): ranks Brazil's 594 senators and federal deputies from official open data (attendance, votes, laws, committee work, expenses) and maps them politically from roll-call votes. Python, JavaScript.
- [Chord.ls](https://github.com/arthurwkm/chord.ls): winning Moises.ai challenge entry; chord recognition per timestamp from audio. Python, ML.
- [EEG Mental State Classifier](https://github.com/arthurwkm/mental-state-classifier): EEG-based mental state classification for brain-computer interfaces, 98.86% eye-state accuracy. Python, scikit-learn, Django.
- [E-Turismo](https://github.com/arthurwkm/e-turismo): AR guided tour of Recife for EPSON Moverio glasses. Java, Android, OpenCV.
- [AR Library](https://github.com/arthurwkm/ar-livraria): Android AR prototype recognizing book covers. Java, ARToolkit.
